== Notes ==
* The conditional energy will be granted to the caster if the caster is under the effects of [[Double Dragon]] or [[Glyph of Immolation]] or the target is under the effects of [[Mark of Rodgort]], since those skills apply [[Burning]] to the target before Glowing Gaze takes effect.
